- In [`Driver.reschedule`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L563-L575), `re.sub(r"\bfrom\b.*?\bto\b", " to ", u, flags=re.I)` strips any appointment ID placed between `from` and `to`, and `re.split(r"\bto\b", u, maxsplit=1, flags=re.I)` splits on the first `"to"` (such as `"to move"` in `"I need to move A03..."`), so `head[0]` no longer contains the appointment number.
- [`Driver.resolve_appt`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L511-L527) is called on `head[0]`; finding no `A\d+` ID, date, time, or provider, it hits `if len(mine) == 1 and not (d or t or provs): return mine[0]` and returns the patient's own appointment instead of `None` (preventing the fallback `resolve_appt(u)` check) or `"not_yours"`. The driver then proposes moving that appointment and commits the move when the patient says yes.
